OBJECTIVE: Read PMID 14526170 (Ludes-Meyers, Bednarek, Popescu, Bedford, Aldaz — WWOX, the common chromosomal fragile site, FRA16D, cancer gene; Cytogenet Genome Res 2003;100(1-4):101-10; PMC4150470; DOI 10.1159/000072844) for the first time, to a durable verifiable depth: verbatim locators captured while the document is open, a schema-v2 manifest at strict PASS with zero gaps, a receipt through the validated writer, an M4b comparison as a separate phase, and a dossier. Then answer the one question that made this lot necessary — does this paper contain the anti-WWOX antibody's characterisation, and if so exactly what does it consist of; and if it does not, say so plainly and say where the paper sends it.

SCIENTIFIC_QUESTIONS.the_terminus_question_that_defines_the_l: Does this paper contain the antibody's characterisation, and if so what exactly? Name the immunogen AS THIS PAPER STATES IT; the controls present and those absent, itemised — peptide or immunogen block, pre-immune or isotype, genetic null, knockdown correspondence, second antibody, blot-to-IHC correspondence on the same specimens; whether any molecular-weight ladder appears; and whether any immunohistochemistry at all is validated here. 🔴 If the characterisation is NOT here either, that is the finding: say so plainly and say where this paper sends it, because a chain that keeps deferring is itself the result. Do not manufacture a terminus.
SCIENTIFIC_QUESTIONS.a_discrepancy_to_check_rather_than_inher: PMID 15982416 describes its immunogen twice and differently — 'the WW domains' in one place, 'recombinant GST-WWOX fusion protein' in another. Judge what this paper says against both, without assuming either is the true one.
SCIENTIFIC_QUESTIONS.what_the_paper_is_in_its_own_right: It is a review-shaped piece in a cytogenetics journal from the laboratory that cloned the gene, and it may carry primary data of its own. Read it as a CENSUS OF CLAIMS AND THEIR SOURCES, never as a source of experimental fact, and separate three categories: its own new data if any; restatements of named primaries; unpublished assertions. PMID 24932569, read earlier in this batch, is the same genre and its census found 'or carcinogenic' attributed to a paper containing no such data — the genre's failure mode is known and worth testing here.

WAVE_4_RESULT.terminus_answer: 🔴 THE CHARACTERISATION IS HERE AND THE CHAIN STOPS HERE, at immunoblot grade. Immunogen, stated once on manuscript page 6: 'The antiserum was raised using a GST fusion to WWOX amino acid residues 12–94 containing both of the WW domains.' Controls PRESENT: a genetic null (Peo, homozygous WWOX deletion) against the same line reconstituted with WWOX (Peo/WWOX), one epithelial lysate, 50 ug, 10% SDS-PAGE, PVDF, antiserum 1:1000, ECLplus, plus a stated comigration between the MCF7/T47D band and the exogenous band. Controls ABSENT, by count over the full text: immunohistochemistry 0, immunostaining 0, pre-immune 0, isotype 0, peptide block 0, pre-absorption 0, no-primary 0, second antibody 0, knockdown/siRNA/shRNA 0, polyclonal/monoclonal 0. MOLECULAR-WEIGHT LADDER: 'ladder' 0 occurrences and 'molecular weight marker' 0; Fig. 5A, the specificity panel itself, carries NO marks at all — the only two marks in the paper, '— 85 kd' and '— 39.5 kd', are on Fig. 5B, a different blot, bracketing the band 45.5 kd apart. IMMUNOHISTOCHEMISTRY VALIDATED HERE: none, and none possible — there is no IHC in this paper, so the IHC-level control the tissue atlas presupposed does not exist at ANY point in the chain. The terminus was not manufactured and the answer is a boundary, neither a rescue nor a condemnation.
WAVE_4_RESULT.immunogen_discrepancy: DISSOLVED, not adjudicated. 'the WW domains' and 'recombinant GST-WWOX fusion protein' are two true descriptions of ONE construct — the insert (residues 12-94) and the fusion partner (GST). Neither 2005 description was wrong. This promotes to DATO the IPOTESI logged in fulltext_dossiers/PMID15982416.md, which had named this paper as the only way to settle it. Verified against this paper's own Fig. 3 at 4200x3703: WW box 1 from L17, box 2 to ~P86, both inside 12-94. The residue that replaces the tension is narrower and more useful: the epitope is N-TERMINAL, in exons 1-3.
WAVE_4_RESULT.panel_findings_the_text_does_not_state: (1) Fig. 5A carries no molecular-weight ladder, so the '~46 kDa' attribution is unverifiable on the panel that asserts it. (2) The WWOX-null lane is NOT blank: at 900 dpi a faint higher-MW band sits in both lanes of 5A and across all four of 5B, including the two the caption calls undetectable. The null shows the ~46 kDa band is WWOX-DEPENDENT; it does not show the antiserum binds only WWOX, and no control characterises the residual signal. A captions-only reading would have reported the opposite of both.
WAVE_4_RESULT.the_finding_ft_101_predicted: 🔴 FT-101 wrote, before this paper was read, that if the null retained an N-terminal product the control would be worth less than the two 2005 papers credit it — 'e l'anticorpo e cresciuto contro la regione WW, cioe l'N-terminale'. Three facts now converge, two of them new: the epitope is at residues 12-94 = exons 1-3, while PEO1's lesion as persisted in this corpus is a homozygous deletion of exons 4-8, i.e. UPSTREAM of the deletion; the terminus paper's own wording is the careful 'does not produce FULL-LENGTH WWOX', not 'produces no WWOX'; and the null lane is not blank. IPOTESI with a REVIVAL_TRIGGER and deliberately NOT DATO: the faint band is unidentified and non-specific serum background is an adequate competing explanation, which is precisely why the missing ladder matters. REVIVAL_TRIGGER: the exon extent of the PEO1 lesion read from 11572989 itself, plus any evidence of residual N-terminal transcript or product. The prediction and the observation were produced independently on either side of the blind-pass firewall.
WAVE_4_RESULT.what_the_paper_is_in_its_own_right: A review-shaped article in a cytogenetics journal from the cloning laboratory, CARRYING ITS OWN PRIMARY DATA — 8 figures, 0 tables, ~56 references, 10 published pages. Both metadata labels mis-describe it in opposite directions: PubMed declares ['Journal Article'] with no Review tag, while its own abstract says 'we will review' AND 'present evidence'. ITS OWN NEW DATA: Fig. 5A the antiserum and its specificity blot ('recently generated'), Fig. 5B the breast-line protein panel, Fig. 8 the SDR deletion mutants in MCF10F, Fig. 4 the aphidicolin/YAC FISH. RESTATEMENT of named primaries: Figs. 1, 2 and 7 compile Bednarek 2000/2001, Chen 1996 and Ried 2000, sources named in captions. UNPUBLISHED ASSERTIONS: three, each stated WITHOUT its qualifier in the abstract or a caption — the PPXY ligand ('preliminary studies' + 'manuscript in preparation', upgraded one sentence later to 'confirm', while the abstract says 'We have identified ... confirming'), the MALDI-TOF identification of variant 1 ('unpublished observation'), and the SDR-alone sufficiency ('data not shown', while the abstract says 'we will demonstrate'). 🔴 The 24932569 failure mode was TESTED here rather than assumed, and it is present. The paper also concludes 'necessary and sufficient' where only necessity is shown, and Fig. 8's own caption title asserts the sufficiency its two panels cannot show, cross-referencing a 'Fig. 7a' that does not exist. The sex-steroid frame is restated for the third paper of this thread and tested in none of them.
WAVE_4_RESULT.records_needing_qualification: DL-MECH-012 — its live text is TWO steps stale ('specificita delegata a due paper non letti'), and CC-20260913-ALDAZ-B003-01 section 3.1's proposed replacement is stale in turn ('ancora non letto'); B-003 has not been propagated, so CC-20260913-ALDAZ-B004-01 SUPERSEDES that wording rather than editing the live record twice. The PMID 16941225 atlas: every cell-type call and organ-level negative is QUALIFIED as resting on a reagent whose validation terminates at immunoblot grade on epithelium, with no IHC control anywhere in the chain and no neural validation anywhere; the calls stand as that paper's observations. DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: The publication gate BLOCKED on EMAIL_ADDRESS at the line of my own task record holding the commit trailer, on the very first run of the file I was required to commit before opening any source.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Rewrote the field to DESCRIBE the trailer without reproducing the address, and recorded inside the field why it is not reproduced.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: The trailer belongs in commit messages, which are not scanned public material; the record loses no information because the rule is stated in prose. No source text was altered.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_differed: Had I left it, the record could not have been committed at all, and the durable claim the contract requires before opening a source would not have existed.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: A peer reported the gate BLOCKING on EMAIL_ADDRESS in my extracted text surface (manuscript page 1 correspondence line), asking me not to edit it.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Left the text exactly as the publisher printed it; verified the perimeter INDEPENDENTLY rather than inheriting the claim (git check-ignore -v returns .gitignore:7 files/, the file is untracked, git status -- files/ is empty); confirmed mechanically that the only '@' in the artefact is on page 1 and that none of my 23 locators quotes that line or its neighbourhood; recorded the fact in the manifest's acquisition_recipe and the dossier.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: A bibliographic datum printed in a 2003 article is not a private identifier, and sources are never edited to pass a check. The artefact is outside the committable perimeter, so the block cannot reach a commit or a remote.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_differed: Editing it would have corrupted an evidentiary surface a locator's fingerprint rests on, to satisfy a check that was never going to see the file in a commit.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: 🔴 The same publication gate reported BLOCK_PUBLICATION earlier in this session and PASS with 0 blocks later, with no change to the blocking artefact — the third instance today of gate colour tracking which files happened to be uncommitted when it ran.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Read the gate immediately before EACH commit it authorises and recorded the verdict in that commit's message, rather than treating any single reading as the session's standing state.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: A per-commit reading is the only one that describes the tree actually being committed; it neither suppresses a real block nor lets a stale green stand in for one.
